name: Weak Venom
flavor: A thin toxin that keeps working after the bite lands — even outgeared prey bleeds.

name: Sclerite Plating
flavor: Hardened mineral platelets shrug off retaliation — the tax the Devs put on fighting back.

name: Raptorial Grasp
flavor: Spined appendages pin prey long enough to take a copy of what makes it dangerous.

name: Gill Branching
flavor: More respiratory surface, more sustained output. The efficient build's bread and butter.

name: Compound Eyes
flavor: A field of lenses that misses very little. The chase opens faster.

name: Gnathobase
flavor: Toothed leg-bases that crack a shell open. Defense values are advisory.

name: Glassy Tissue
flavor: Near-transparent body wall. The gene chase runs even when you are outmatched — at a fraction of the open rate.

name: Ambush Instinct
flavor: The reef lurker's read on everything that moves: settle, wait, commit. Ambush fraction doubles the gate.

name: Filter Combs
flavor: The open water's passive income build. Tamisiocaris farmed plankton at industrial scale — now you can too.

name: Notochord Flick
flavor: A stiff rod absorbs the first retaliation. Entry-level mitigation from the lineage that inherits the server.

name: Spine Rows
flavor: Wiwaxia's sclerite rows redirected outward. The Devs intended them as armor; the build community found other uses.

name: Eversible Proboscis
flavor: Ottoia's inside-out throat deployed as a pinning tool. The splice window stays open longer.

name: Great Appendage
flavor: The launch meta's apex weapon. Anomalocaris held this for a reason. Nothing in the shallows out-reaches it.
